name: appstats-local
_comment: The real-app code path on the standalone target: WHEP through the shim's app-like proxy (like http://<host>:8889/{stream}/whep), the shim's /api/stats (app statistics contract v 1) as the ONLY target statistics (MediaMTX API not used), quality mix source/720p. Reference rates, target session count, cleanup and the degraded-quality stop all come from /api/stats. Stage 75 is meant to exceed this PC's same-host target (~400 Mbit/s) so the degraded-below-min stop is exercised.
